user.title: Home Tasks
user.description: Choose what you want to set up.

native.title: Create Task List
native.description: Enter a name for the new task list.

external.title: Link External Todo List
external.description: Select an external todo entity to enhance with Home Tasks features (priority, tags, sub-tasks, etc.).

plan.title: Create Day Plan
plan.description: A day plan shows tasks from your lists that are meant for today and the next days. The tasks stay in their lists.

error.empty_name: The name must not be empty.
error.name_too_long: The name is too long (max 100 characters).
error.duplicate_name: A list with this name already exists.
error.duplicate_plan_name: A plan with this name already exists.

abort.no_external_entities: No external todo entities found. Please set up a CalDAV, Google Tasks, or Microsoft ToDo integration first.

data.include_due: Show tasks with a due date on their day
data.carry_over: Unfinished tasks of the last planned day

data_description.source_lists: The lists this plan may show tasks from. Nothing selected means all lists.
data_description.workdays: The days this plan has. Other days are skipped. Nothing selected means every day.
data_description.include_due: A task that is due on a day off appears on the workday before it; overdue tasks appear today.
